funding.value: U of A guarantees every PhD student at least CAD 100,000 over years 1-4 and at least CAD 25,000 in year 1 (not sponsored or part-time students).
funding.quote: minimum guaranteed funding of $100K CAD over four years and not less than $25K CAD in their first year

entry_route.value: You can enter the PhD after a bachelor's (27 units of coursework) or after a master's (12 units).
entry_route.quote: Students entering the PhD program after a master’s degree are required to complete a minimum of 12.0 units in coursework and a thesis. | Students entering the PhD program after a bachelor’s degree are required to complete a minimum of 27.0 units in coursework and a thesis.

notes: Minimum admission GPA 3.0/4. TOEFL 93 (old scale) or 4.5 (new scale); IELTS 6.5.
